card.name: Inside capitalized EMBRYO-FETAL in warnings
card.fires_on: The letter O at the end of EMBRY in the all-caps phrase EMBRYO-FETAL TOXICITY in boxed warning headings. It also fires on the V in AGGRAVATE in all-caps text.

modes.label: EMBRYO-FETAL heading
modes.description: The final O of EMBRY(O) just before the hyphen in the all-caps boxed warning title.
modes.example: WARNING: DIARRHEA AND EMBRY<<O>>-FETAL TOXICITY Z

modes.description: The V partway through AGGRAVATE in all-caps warning text.
